title: Greenwood Cemetery began 1912 by Reformed Baptist Church
description: In 1912-13, under the ministries of Rev. H. S. Dow and Rev. P. J. Trafton, the Reformed Baptist Church began work on a cemetery. The land at the end of High Street, donated by G Burtt, W. P. MacMullin, and J Bradley, was used for this purpose. The church maintained the cemetery until 1922, with George Grey serving as caretaker.
